name: atlas-app
description: ATLAS — AI hiring for blue-collar workers (React client + Express server)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
